name: checkClass

origin.description: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is an object that inherits the given classes.
origin.usage: checkClass(x, classes, ordered = FALSE, null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.text: When true, classes or factor levels must be in this order.
